critical_code_review_comments: NumberTicker in Hero uses useInView with once:true — expected behavior, but keep in mind stats show 0 until scrolled into view. Consider triggering earlier or using threshold if stats need to animate on load.

Inner text checks for section headings/labels (e.g. 'Why RabbitPay', 'Your Store', footer columns) render in UPPERCASE via CSS text-transform. DOM source is title-case — automated testers must use case-insensitive checks or query source text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is static (no backend). All data-testids present as specified in PRD. Framer-motion 'filter' warnings appear in console but are non-blocking. NumberTicker requires viewport entry to animate (useInView, once:true). Text inside sections is uppercased via CSS; when asserting inner_text, use case-insensitive comparison. Marquee duplicates brand elements ~4x, so [data-testid=brand-*] count returns 4 per brand — that's normal.
